requirements.originalBreakdownItem: Synchronize that language across all screens.
requirements.changes: Locale resolution retains exact script identity; explicit Traditional/Simplified Chinese choices cannot fall through to an ambiguous generic Chinese bundle. Valid translations identical to their keys are recognized using a missing-resource sentinel. Source-language fallback can resolve authored English resource values while preserving explicit caller wording. Resolution exposes actual resource language for native speech hints. User-authored/unkeyed text remains unlocalized. Settings explicitly disclose incomplete interface coverage separately from research/answer readiness.
requirements.verification: Five Bundle-resource resolution tests and three real hosted UILabel tests were added, including script isolation, fallback, key-equal translations, speech metadata and unkeyed user text. Not executed on Mac. No inference or translation model was run.
requirements.remainingIssues: Catalog coverage and native-language review remain incomplete. Run existing persistence/RTL/Chinese selector journeys and these native tests on founder Mac; do not infer full multilingual clinical acceptance.
